$comment: Layer 13 WP-13.4 `find`/`grep` canonical shape, discriminated by a top-level `builtin_search` key, in conformance/agent/builtin-search/. A runner builds the named corpus from conformance/agent/builtin-search/corpus.json in a fresh temporary directory that has no `.git` above it, constructs the real tool over the real local ctx.fs and ctx.subprocess with the CERTIFIED pinned engine store (TOOL-038), and runs the case through the real Layer 06 execute pipeline. Expectations are generated from the pinned-Pi search_probe outputs (minion-agent-docs assurance/layers/data/13-wp134/out/search-{win32,linux}.json), keyed by host platform; a host whose platform has no expectation skips the case. Normalization, never behaviour: the corpus root becomes `<ROOT>` in the result text and details. Cross-entry and cross-file order is unspecified (Owner Q2), so `mode` selects an order-insensitive comparison: `find_multiset` (formatted entries as a multiset), `find_subset` (a limited result: exactly `count` entries, a sub-multiset of `of`), `grep_by_file` (each file's lines exact, in order and contiguous; files in any order), `summary` (bulk: counts, bytes, notice and details without the order-dependent truncation content), `exact`.
